comments: 7ce05fa4: ;If entry has a STATUS CODE, store it.

13cebad3: ;If field is read-only and user has no edit access, display message.
565ebe56: Check for valid data at this control; if so, store the response and go to the next control.
d9d32b98: If the response is null and no range is specified, go to the next question. If no range and the response is null, quit. If the minimum data length is exceeded, go to the next question.
a198e806: If the response is a question mark, branch to the help section. If the response begins with an up-arrow, execute cleanup code and quit.
c730ec74: If the response is an at-sign, execute auxiliary code and continue.
9c0634be: If the response is a space and this is a date field with an internal value defined, use the internal value as the response. If not a date field, display the internal value.

ce2a793f: Depending on the field type, branch to process the response or validate the data. If the data is valid and the DDER flag is set, perform additional validation; otherwise, display the data with the appropriate caption.
8519a979: Clean up the DDER flag and continue processing.
20476554: If this is a pointer field, set the DIC variables and execute the lookup utility. If the lookup is successful, store the IEN of the selected entry and continue processing.
e4f4e0d2: If this is a numeric field, check for a valid number format. If the number exceeds the maximum allowed digits, reject it and redisplay the field.
508c2df7: If this is a computed numeric expression, evaluate the expression and store the result as a number.
9b338806: Execute any special computed code defined for this field.
7c49d66d: Store the new response value internally. If this is a date field, also store the external value in the local DISV global for later retrieval.
64dda479: If the editing session was not initiated through TaskMan, write a ? to indicate an invalid response. If the response was from a HELP prompt, execute HELP cleanup.
b6ae9a1d: Set the response to ?BAD to indicate an invalid value.
8fc9188c: If the response is a question mark, execute field HELP and redisplay the field.
